description: Run a multi-device scenario on any app: up, install, per-device actions (Maestro flow / intent / adb) + network schedule, drain, judge (proxy log by default), down (minutes). Give `file` (scenario JSON, docs/guide-your-app.md) OR, with no file, apk + flows + server (setupFlow, count, repeat, network optional).

apk.description: no-file form: your APK (package read from it)

file.description: scenario JSON, e.g. scenarios/photo-upload.json; omit to use apk/flows/server

flows.description: no-file form: Maestro flows run in order every iteration

network.description: no-file form: false = no network faults (default: all four states)

server.description: no-file form: backend as the host sees it, http://host:port

setupFlow.description: no-file form: Maestro flow run once per device first

name: run
